name: at-eli-mcp
description: Austrian law with verifiable citations, from the federal legal information system RIS (open data API at data.bka.gv.at): search federal legislation and fetch its text with ELI identifiers, and search court decisions and fetch their text with ECLI. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to RIS; nothing goes to MateMatic.
